dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Host - Infrastructure
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for backend host CPU, load, memory, swap, disk, network, and top process resource use. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(cpuPercent), average(loadAverageOneMinute), average(loadAverageFiveMinute) FROM SystemSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(memoryUsedPercent), average(swapUsedPercent) FROM SystemSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(diskUsedPercent) FROM StorageSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET mountPoint TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(readBytesPerSecond), average(writeBytesPerSecond), average(ioUtilizationPercent) FROM StorageSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(receiveBytesPerSecond), average(transmitBytesPerSecond) FROM NetworkSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(receiveErrorsPerSecond), average(transmitErrorsPerSecond) FROM NetworkSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(cpuPercent), latest(commandName) FROM ProcessSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET processDisplayName LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(memoryResidentSizeBytes), latest(commandName) FROM ProcessSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET processDisplayName LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
